scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic/combinatorial and is self-contained after the cited element characterization. Finite exhaustive checks are corroborative. No assertions of independent audit or global novelty certification.
scientific_limitations: Counts order-, parity-, and two-sided-fence-preserving partial injections only. Uses the published three-gap characterization. Asymptotics are for integer n tending to infinity; no rate beyond the main equivalent is claimed. Results are not independently validated and global priority remains provisional.
title: Algebraic cardinality series and sharp growth of parity-preserving fence inverse monoids
